scripts.setup: cd packages/ear-dream-api && uv sync && cd ../.. && pnpm generate:api-types && pnpm setup:model-bundle
scripts.dev:api: cd packages/ear-dream-api && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/setup-mediapipe-assets.mjs && node scripts/setup-fonts.mjs && pnpm --filter @ear-dream/app web
scripts.build:web-mobile: node scripts/setup-mediapipe-assets.mjs && node scripts/setup-fonts.mjs && cd packages/ear-dream-app && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL= npx expo export --platform web && cd ../.. && node scripts/precompress-dist.mjs
scripts.lint:api: cd packages/ear-dream-api && uv run ruff check .
